text:
ria (People Ops): Thinking about a small, recurring 'Quarterly Lightning' recognition push tied to our Q2 wrap. Goal: fast nominations, same-week digital delivery, optional desk-drop for office folks. Want to pilot with a $20 e-gift + sticker + printed thank-you slip. Who can help run ops? :zap:
ben (Events): Happy to coordinate desk-drops for SF and NYC offices. For international teammates, stickers + e-gift only. Need lead time 7 days if we add printed slips.
olga (Payroll): Quick note: we need legal name + work email for records. Anything under $600/yr per person still needs to be logged. Recommend a consistent CSV template so we can ingest quickly.
diego (Finance): Budget projection: if 200 awards at $20 = $4k, plus $200 for printed slips and shipping. I can provision a $5k spot-award GL once you confirm timing.
ria (People Ops): Thanks. Lean process: nominations open Wed - Fri (3 days), People Ops compiles Sat morning, send e-gifts Mon. Desk-drops go out Monday afternoon. Is that doable?
ben (Events): Tight but doable for offices if we lock vendors Mon prior. For printed slips, I'll look at same-week local print shops. Suggest stickers pre-ordered to avoid delays.
olga (Payroll): For speed: bulk e-gift CSV upload is ideal. If you need individual manual sends it's going to add 1-2 days. I'll share a CSV template with the required columns by EOD.
diego (Finance): Also confirm whether we want vendor-issued e-gift codes (single invoice) vs. prepaid cards. Vendor codes simplify accounting.
recognition-bot: FYI: prior quarterly run had 132 recipients and average delivery time 4 days. Consider a 72-hour SLA if you want same-week delivery.
ria (People Ops): Good data point. Plan: Pilot run dates: nominations open Mon Jun 2 - Wed Jun 4. Send e-gifts Mon Jun 9. Desk-drops Mon Jun 9 in SF/NYC. Action items:
- ben: confirm sticker stock + local print shops by Fri May 24
- olga: CSV template and import checklist by Fri May 24
- diego: set GL and confirm vendor payment preference by Mon May 27
- ria: draft announcement copy and lightweight nomination form by Wed May 22
Please react with :white_check_mark: if you can take these.
ben (Events): :white_check_mark:
olga (Payroll): :white_check_mark:
diego (Finance): :white_check_mark:
ria (People Ops): One Q: anonymous nominations? I prefer allow anonymous but require a contact method if the nominator wants a follow-up. Keep it optional.
ben (Events): Works. Also flag: international shipping requires customs declarations for physical items; if any, include country on form.
olga (Payroll): Yep capture country and employee ID if possible. Makes records cleaner.
diego (Finance): If you want same-week delivery, vendor bulk codes are the fastest. I can reach out to our usual gift vendor for turnaround times.
recognition-bot: Reminder scheduled: check-in to #people-ops on 1791239000 to confirm vendor lead.
ria (People Ops): Great. I'll post draft announcement tomorrow and loop back once invoices are set. Keeping this low-friction and celebratory. Thanks team!
